new_value: Destination address validation is already implemented at the stack layer, not the link layer - this is intentional architecture. wire_is_for_local_stack() in stack.rs (lines 715-743) filters frames by destination BEFORE calling receive_frame(). Additionally, AuthenticatedFrame::is_unicast_for() (link_layer.rs:368-371) is provided for callers needing to check destination. The separation allows: (1) filter-before-crypto efficiency, (2) different filtering policies (promiscuous mode, forwarding). No code change needed.
